messages.subject: iPlots question
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have been using iPlots and have found it to be a great addition to R.
I do have a question though, when I run a simple script like this one:

library(iplots)
setwd("C:/Users/ROunadjela/Desktop/")
data<- read.csv("iplot.csv", header = TRUE, sep=",")
iplot(data$SerialNumber, data$Value, "Serial Number", "Value")

A scatterplot appears.
When pressing the <Ctrl> key and hovering over a point, both the X and Y values appear (in my case, Serial Number and Value).
My question is this:
In the .CSV file I load there is a third column: Date&Time, is there any way to make this third number appear when I hover over points in my scatterplot?

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Kind Regards,
RO
